description: This source file implements a sample application demonstrating privileged request handling, file sharing, and inter-process communication using shared files and descriptors. It includes a server class with callback mechanisms, file management functions, and a command-line interface for interaction.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A privileged request server managing shared files and handling descriptor requests and offers.

classes.name: Server::Callback
classes.description: Callback class for handling request and offer events in the server.

methods.name: ParseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine server mode and identifier.

methods.name: LoadFiles
methods.description: Creates temporary shared files, opens them, and writes initial data.

methods.name: Server::Server
methods.description: Constructor initializing server with shared files.

methods.name: Server::~Server
methods.description: Destructor closing and cleaning up shared files.

methods.name: Server::Request
methods.description: Handles request for file descriptors, providing up to a maximum per request.

methods.name: Server::Offer
